title: Natural continuous-function presentations of internal modules
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $A$ a totally disconnected topological commutative ring and $N$ a topological additive group with a continuous $A$-module action. Let $Q$ be an internal module over the continuous coefficients $A_X$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Using the actual sectionwise encoding $F_X$ of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding], a continuous-function presentation consists of additive equivalences $(F_XQ)(V)\simeq C(|V|,N)$ for every pro-etale $V\to X$. They commute with restriction by precomposition and satisfy $e_V(a\cdot x)=a\cdot e_V(x)$ for every continuous scalar function $a:|V|\to A$, with the universe lift used by the section ring. No basis or freeness of $N$ is part of this data.
